one_line: Anthropic completed an $81.3B IPO, Google and Anthropic released advanced AI models, and major regulatory and security incidents unfolded globally.

themes.title: Anthropic completes record IPO
themes.text: Anthropic completed an initial public offering raising $81.3 billion and achieving a valuation of roughly $1.7 trillion. Early investor Dustin Moskovitz noted he originally invested to promote safety rather than a race, as founders cashed out $2 billion.

stories.headline: Anthropic raises $81.3B in record-breaking IPO as founders cash out $2B
Early Anthropic investor Dustin Moskovitz says labs should slow down
Anthropic IPO retail investor allocation expected to fall below 20%

themes.title: New model releases and scientific breakthroughs
themes.text: Google released the Gemini 4 Neon midtier model for complex workflows and added a computer use feature to Gemini for macOS. Meanwhile, Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 solved two open problems in black hole physics.

stories.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon model for complex workflows
Google adds computer use to Gemini for macOS
Anthropic's Claude model solves two open problems in black hole physics

themes.title: Security breaches and legal investigations
themes.text: Hackers compromised Microsoft's Agent Framework PyPI package with malicious versions designed to steal credentials. Additionally, Arizona opened a criminal investigation into OpenAI and other firms over rogue AI agents, and students sued over a false-positive AI gun alert.

stories.headline: Microsoft's Agent Framework PyPI package compromised with credential stealer
Arizona investigates OpenAI and other firms over rogue AI agents
Students sue school and police after chip bag triggers AI gun alert

themes.title: Export controls and geopolitical scrutiny
themes.text: US lawmakers asked Microsoft to brief them on a reported $500 million deal allowing ByteDance to access OpenAI models via Azure. Separately, reports detailed how Alibaba accessed Nvidia chips via regional companies to support a military-linked lab.

stories.headline: Alibaba used regional companies to access Nvidia chips and aid military-linked lab
US lawmakers seek Microsoft briefing on reported ByteDance AI deal
